title: The Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: SHN -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy early‑morning US Festival set captured on a solid soundboard with standout China Cat > Rider and an epic Shakedown.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑preserved soundboard capture that settles into clear, punchy mix after a slightly rough start. The show bursts with morning intensity – tight, fast jams like China Cat > Rider, a blistering Shakedown, and a memorable Space > Not Fade Away sequence – making it one of the most exciting short sets of ’82.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, praising both performance and recording; only minor mix issues are noted, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Initial mix is a bit off/on the low end but settles quickly; overall crisp and balanced after early moments, patched/pitch‑corrected version improves consistency.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A turbo‑charged first set that launches at 9 AM with rapid transitions and high tempo, followed by a slightly more relaxed second set featuring spacey improvisation and classic closers.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's power chords and soaring lead work drive the intense jams, especially on Minglewood and China Cat.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir adds a gritty slide tone that weaves through the high‑energy guitar work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are bright but occasionally distorted; his adventurous approach shines on Shakedown and Space.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s drumming is dynamic and tight, providing a strong backbone to the early‑morning intensity.
